Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and everywhere in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.
People are at the center of all we do, and that’s why we empower career growth, provide industry-leading benefits packages, encourage a flexible work environment, and foster a culture of inclusion to support the needs of our team. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.
We are seeking a Principal to grow and lead our state and local government consulting work. This leader will develop the market strategy, build executive relationships, win new business, and oversee consulting engagements that help public agencies improve operations and services for the people they serve.
The ideal candidate brings established government relationships and a record of selling and delivering consulting services. Working across Attain’s strategy, technology, and data teams, the Principal will build a sustainable portfolio of business and develop the consulting talent needed to support its growth.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development and Client Relationship Management
Develop and execute a growth strategy that identifies priority markets, agency needs, target accounts, and opportunities for Attain’s services.
Build trusted relationships with state and local executives, agency leaders, and procurement stakeholders; expand existing accounts and establish new clients.
Personally originate and close consulting engagements, with accountability for agreed bookings, revenue, and profitability goals.
Lead pursuits from opportunity qualification through proposals, presentations, pricing, negotiations, and contracting, in partnership with internal teams.
Develop teaming relationships and maintain a qualified pipeline, account plans, and reliable forecasts.
Collaboration with Delivery Leaders
Partner with capability and delivery leaders to identify, qualify, and pursue state and local government opportunities aligned with Attain’s offerings and delivery strengths.
Develop joint account and pursuit plans that define client needs, key relationships, competitive positioning, and responsibilities for advancing opportunities.
Engage delivery leaders early to shape solutions, validate scope and staffing, and develop compelling proposals and presentations.
Collaborate on pricing and contracting strategies that balance competitive positioning, delivery risk, and profitability.
Coordinate with delivery leaders on existing accounts to identify expansion opportunities and connect clients with additional Attain capabilities.
Ensure a coordinated transition from pursuit to delivery, maintaining alignment on commitments, client expectations, and success measures.

Build relationships with state and local government sales and alliance teams at strategic technology partners, including, but not limited to, Salesforce, Snowflake, and Workday.

Connect technology partner teams with Attain’s delivery leaders to shape solutions and demonstrate relevant expertise.

Collaborate on targeted campaigns, events, and thought leadership that generate qualified opportunities and increase Attain’s visibility.
Translate partner insights on agency priorities, procurement timelines, and technology roadmaps into actionable market and pursuit strategies.
Consulting Delivery
Serve as an executive advisor and engagement leader on organizational transformation, business process improvement, program management, and technology modernization initiatives.
Translate agency priorities into practical recommendations, delivery plans, and measurable improvements in program performance and constituent services.
Oversee engagement scope, staffing, budgets, quality, and risk; resolve escalations and maintain client confidence.
Connect clients with Attain specialists in areas such as data and analytics, change management, grants management, and enterprise technology.
Recruit, coach, and develop consultants and engagement leaders; align staffing and capability investments with anticipated demand.
Build repeatable service offerings and consulting methods that address emerging state and local government needs.
Manage portfolio performance, including engagement margins, resource utilization, client satisfaction, and account growth.
Represent Attain through industry associations, conferences, and thought leadership; share market insights across practices.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
10+ years of progressive experience in management consulting or professional services, including substantial work with U.S. state and local government clients.
5+ years leading consulting teams, client accounts, or a service offering with responsibility for business development and financial performance.
Demonstrated success personally winning and expanding consulting engagements, supported by measurable sales or revenue results.
Established relationships with government decision-makers and an understanding of public procurement, budget cycles, solicitations, and contracting approaches.
Experience leading complex consulting engagements involving multiple stakeholders and delivering results within scope and budget.
Strong executive communication, proposal development, facilitation, and negotiation skills.

Experience building a state and local government consulting portfolio, entering new markets, or launching service offerings.
Expertise in one or more government domains, such as finance and administration, health and human services, transportation, public safety, or grants administration.
Experience combining management consulting with technology implementation, data and analytics, or organizational change.
Advanced degree in business, public administration, public policy, or a related field.

Ability to balance business development, client delivery, and team leadership in a growing consulting environment.
Willingness to travel for client engagements, pursuits, and firm activities based on business needs.

The Role
The Lead DevOps Engineer owns the technical direction, standards and delivery of IREN's AWS platform and DevOps practice. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you'll set the architecture and governance model for our AWS estate — multi-account landing zone, guardrails, IAM, networking, pipelines and observability — lead and mentor DevOps Engineers, and be the escalation point for cloud platform design and delivery decisions across the enterprise and our AI Cloud business. You'll partner with Cybersecurity, Compliance and Business Systems leaders so the platform is secure by design, audit-ready and cost-efficient.
AWS is the primary platform. IREN also runs a Microsoft Azure/M365 estate for identity and productivity, so you'll own the integration standards between the two clouds — identity federation, shared pipelines, monitoring and evidence collection — and be able to step into Azure work when needed.
This role sits within IREN's corporate Information Technology team and is a critical hire to remove single points of failure on production cloud platform work.
Responsibilities
Architecture & governance
Define and own the AWS platform architecture: AWS Organizations and multi-account landing zone (Control Tower or equivalent), SCP guardrails, Config/Security Hub conformance, network topology (VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect/VPN to sites) and tagging and naming standards.
Design identity and access controls — IAM Identity Center federated with Entra ID, least-privilege role design, no long-lived credentials, Secrets Manager/KMS — with Cybersecurity and Network Engineering.
Own the cross-cloud integration standards with Azure/M365: identity federation, shared CI/CD, unified observability and consistent control evidence across both estates.
Lead security-by-design and compliance automation so that pipelines and platform controls produce SOX and ISO 27001 evidence by default (AWS Config, CloudTrail, Audit Manager).
Engineering leadership
Lead, mentor and develop DevOps Engineers: work planning, code and design review, technical coaching and performance input.
Set and enforce Terraform/OpenTofu module libraries, branching/release strategy and pipeline patterns across GitHub Actions and AWS CodePipeline (and Azure DevOps where it remains); standardize GitOps (Argo CD) for ECS/EKS workloads.
Remove single points of failure through documentation, pairing and shared on-call.
Reliability & operations
Own platform reliability: SLOs, monitoring and alerting standards (CloudWatch, Grafana/Prometheus, PagerDuty routing), backup/DR strategy with tested restores, and incident/problem management.
Act as senior escalation for cloud platform incidents across AWS and Azure; lead RCAs and post-incident reviews; manage AWS Support engagements.
Roadmap, cost & vendors
Drive the platform roadmap, FinOps/cost optimization (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, rightsizing, tagging compliance) and technical-debt reduction; evaluate new AWS services and AI-enabled operational tooling.
Manage the AWS and Microsoft relationships (Enterprise Support/EA, licensing, architecture reviews) and key vendor escalations.
Communicate platform status, risks and decisions to IT leadership and stakeholders across time zones.

7+ years in DevOps, platform or cloud engineering, with at least 4 years designing and operating AWS at enterprise scale (multi-account, production, regulated).
Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring engineers and owning technical delivery for a team.
Expert IaC with Terraform/OpenTofu (CloudFormation/CDK transferable) and CI/CD design (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, GitLab or Azure DevOps), including reusable module and pipeline libraries.
Deep knowledge of AWS Organizations, Control Tower/landing zones, IAM and Identity Center, VPC networking and hybrid connectivity, and AWS security services (GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, CloudTrail, KMS).
Production experience with containers on ECS and/or EKS and GitOps delivery.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Entra ID — resource model, RBAC, Conditional Access, identity federation — sufficient to own cross-cloud integration and cover Azure platform work.
Strong Python and Bash (boto3, AWS CLI); PowerShell a plus.
Proven experience operating platforms in regulated environments and producing SOX/ISO 27001 audit evidence.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field, or equivalent experience.

AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or DevOps Engineer – Professional; AWS Security Specialty; HashiCorp Terraform Associate; CKA.
Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305 or AZ-400) and hands-on Bicep, Azure Policy and Azure Monitor/KQL.
Experience supporting hyperscaler-customer production environments or GPU/AI cloud platforms (e.g., Mirantis k0rdent, bare-metal provisioning).

description:

What you'll do
Migrations

Microsoft 365 and Entra ID

Required qualifications

1. Microsoft 365 administration
• Exchange Online: mail flow, connectors, transport rules, shared and resource mailboxes, mailbox delegation, message trace, retention basics
• Mail DNS: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Autodiscover, and what TTL does to a cutover

• Compliance policies, configuration profiles, and the Settings Catalog

• Active Directory domain migration or consolidation: ADMT, SID history, forest trusts, UPN suffix change, workstation re-domain
• Another MDM platform into Intune

• Hyper-V setup and configuration
7. PowerShell
• Bulk operations against Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph, and Entra
• You read and modify scripts rather than only running ones you found

• Client-facing: comfortable explaining a downtime window to a non-technical stakeholder.

рахуємо не тільки маркетингову атрибуцію, а й крос-продуктову
робота з безліччю джерел: Google Analytics, Amplitude, рекламні кабінети, зовнішні API, DWH
побудова та оптимізація дата-пайплайнів у Airflow (MWAA)

title: Director, AI Product Management (GTM)
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
Samsara's Go-To-Market AI product team builds the internal products our sellers, customer success managers, and support reps use every day. As Director, AI Product Management (GTM), you will own an AI-powered GTM platform that creates a step change in impact, brings in new ways of working, centralizes data and insights, and acts as the foundational system for our GTM organization—from problem identification to development, adoption, and measurable business impact.
Functioning much like a general manager with product at the core, this broad leadership role requires you to build, coach, and grow a high-performing team of product managers while driving enablement, cross-functional alignment, and strategic execution.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.
In this role, you will:
Own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our internal AI-native GTM platform, and be accountable for whether the business adopts it.
Manage the platform as one portfolio, so every part of it shares the same data, intelligence and building blocks, and users get one consistent experience.
Build an AI-native product practice. Take the best of traditional product management, such as PRDs, prioritization, launch readiness and measurement, and reinvent it with AI so the team moves faster and builds better.
Understand internal users' problems and analyze data to identify what to build, sometimes finding the need before users can articulate it.
Write clear requirements and partner closely with engineering, which leads technical implementation, to deliver a high-quality product. Make sure you and your team test the product firsthand.
Keep pace with an engineering team that moves fast and ships at high velocity. Gather input from the field quickly, turn it into a clear direction for engineering, and use AI to shorten the loop from feedback to shipped improvement.
Define what quality means for AI products, including accuracy, trust, evaluation and human review, and hold every release to that bar.
Drive adoption by coaching sellers and partnering with Sales Enablement and Product Marketing, and measure the business impact of what you ship.
Set clear, measurable goals for adoption, productivity and business impact, instrument the product to track them, and use the results to decide what to build next.
Resolve cross-functional dependencies, such as aligning teams on shared datasets with Data Engineering or getting Product Marketing content into the AI knowledge base, and take on the analytics and operational work needed to make the product succeed.
Use AI tools in your own work to build prototypes and mini-apps that engineers can take forward into production, and apply AI to improve how Samsara's go-to-market teams work. Hands-on AI experience is a requirement for this role.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team of product managers.
Minimum requirements for the role:
10+ years of experience in product management, or in strategy and operations roles where you owned a product built with engineering.
5+ years of experience leading, developing and mentoring product managers or product-oriented teams, while staying close to execution.
Demonstrated ownership of an internal or business-facing product, including defining the problem, working with engineering to deliver it, driving adoption and showing measurable business impact.
Hands-on experience with AI, such as building or shipping AI-enabled products, using AI tools in your own work, or prototyping with them.
Strong analytical skills, with examples of using data to identify problems, shape product decisions and measure results.
Technical fluency and ability to establish credibility with engineers.
Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with a record of driving work to completion across teams and stakeholders.
An ideal candidate also has:
Experience owning internal tools or AI products used by sales, customer success or other go-to-market teams.
Familiarity with the systems and data that run a go-to-market organization, such as CRM, forecasting and sales enablement tools.
Experience defining quality, evaluation and trust standards for AI products.
Experience coaching end users and working with enablement teams to get a new tool used.
Experience leading product teams that use AI throughout their own work, from research and requirements to prototyping and launch.
Comfort with fast-changing priorities and with the cross-functional alignment that a company at Samsara's scale requires.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

$157,080—$280,500 USD
Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. Belonging at Samsara

title: Capture Engineer
description:
About Nava
Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.
Position summary
The Capture Engineer is a territory-based specialist and the primary client-facing role within Nava’s State BD function. This role owns the full capture loop within an assigned portfolio of states - from first signal through close - developing state-specific strategies, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders, translating market intelligence into qualified leads, and coordinating cross-functionally to position Nava as the preferred partner before RFPs drop.
The Capture Engineer role brings increased technical rigor, AI-native operating habits, and self-reliance in generating materials and running outbound strategy. The role is designed to compress the specialist-handoff architecture that previously split relationship coverage, technical credibility, and pursuit strategy across multiple people.
What you'll do
Territory Strategy & Capture Planning
Own a portfolio of 3–5 states; develop and maintain a territory capture plan for each state defining ICPs, political context, trigger conditions, relationship maps, assets in market, and 90-day activity plans
Develop state-specific win strategies that include identification of target opportunities, understanding of political and procurement context, and prioritized next actions
Translate market intelligence from the RevOps/BD Analyst layer into qualified leads and recommended actions tied to specific opportunities
Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, and working sessions with state agency stakeholders; pull in Solutions Architects only where technical depth genuinely requires it
Conduct pre-RFP requirement shaping conversations with agency stakeholders to define procurement requirements that favor Nava’s approach
Stakeholder Relationship Management
Build and maintain warm, trust-based relationships with 8–12 state agency contacts per territory, including economic buyers, technical evaluators, political blockers, and internal champions
Deliver value-additive touchpoints to stakeholders — peer state intelligence, federal guidance, relevant case studies — without explicit asks
Hold credible conversations with state CIOs and agency program directors on agency strategic priorities, federal compliance environment, technical architecture, and operational challenges without needing a lifeline
Represent Nava at relevant conferences, state-level events, and industry gatherings within assigned territories
AI-Native Content & Asset Generation
Self-generate outbound materials including one-pagers, briefing packets, state-specific capability summaries, and demo assets using AI-native tools and Nava’s institutional knowledge base
Develop product-based wedge materials — prototypes, demonstration assets, and click-engagement content — that support the state product-led go-to-market motion
Operate with an AI-first orientation across intelligence gathering, asset creation, synthesis, and outbound strategy; use AI tools to reduce time on tasks that do not require human judgment
Pursuit & Pipeline Contribution
Own win theme development and pursuit strategy on below-threshold opportunities; co-lead with the Capture Manager on above-threshold pursuits
Surface opportunity signals into the pipeline — budget shifts, personnel changes, federal compliance pressure, peer state movements — each tied to a recommended next action
Coordinate with RevOps so intelligence flows bidirectionally, oriented to the territory capture plan
Identify when a POC or product demonstration is the right next move; design and lead those engagements with Solutions Architect depth pulled in as needed
Required skills
Experience: 3–7 years in a client-facing, capture, business development, or territory management role in a government technology, civic tech, or public sector consulting environment
Government & program fluency: Working knowledge of state government agency operations, federal compliance environment, and the programs Nava serves (SNAP, Medicaid, UI, PFML, child care). Able to hold substantive conversations with agency leaders without needing a subject matter expert in the room
Technical credibility: Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with technical buyers (state CIOs, CDOs, agency architects) on implementation approach, data systems, and technology modernization. Does not require engineering depth, but must demonstrate enough technical fluency to engage credibly when technical questions arise
Capture & sales motion evidence: Track record of building relationships in a government procurement context, shaping requirements pre-RFP, and developing win strategies on competitive pursuits
AI-native orientation: Active user of AI tools for research, writing, synthesis, and outbound asset generation. Treats AI as a core productivity layer, not a novelty
Self-reliance & high motor: Proactively generates assets, surfaces insights, and moves territory strategy forward without needing to be directed. Comfortable producing first drafts and prototype materials independently

Je werkt binnen een ICT-ontwikkeldienst die de samenwerking tussen planning, ontwikkeling en beheer verder structureert. In een later stadium help je deze werkwijze uitbreiden naar andere .NET-ontwikkelteams, zodat een uniforme aanpak ontstaat.

Je vertaalt organisatiebrede architectuurkaders en gekozen oplossingsrichtingen samen met projectteams en lead developers naar een concrete, uitvoerbare technische aanpak.
Afstemming met enterprise-, solution-, data-, security- en integratiearchitectuur.

Documenteren van keuzes, alternatieven en trade-offs via Architecture Decision Records.
Tijdig terugkoppelen over haalbaarheid, afwijkingen en impact.

Bewaken van Definition of Ready, Definition of Done en release readiness.
3. Security, privacy, risico en compliance

Toepassen van security-by-design en privacy-by-design tijdens de realisatie.
Leveren van input voor threat modeling en uitwerken van concrete technische mitigaties.
Bewaken van secrets management, identity, logging, auditability en supply-chain security.
Escaleren van materiële risico’s en opvolgen van kwetsbaarheden.

Geven van technisch go/no-go-advies en ondersteuning tijdens de early-life-fase.
Technisch leiden van security-incidenten en root-causeanalyses, in afstemming met de securityverantwoordelijke en het bevoegde securityoverleg.

Inventariseren en waarderen van technische schuld.
Opvolgen van versies, end-of-support, licenties en capaciteitslimieten.
Uitwerken van moderniseringsvoorstellen op basis van risico, waarde, kost en veranderbaarheid.
Voorkomen van lokale optimalisaties die het applicatielandschap complexer maken.

Organiseren van coaching, pairing, kennisdeling en communities of practice.
Geven van concrete vakinhoudelijke feedback en ondersteunen van onboarding en hiring.

Creëren van ruimte voor technische tegenspraak en vroege escalatie.

Be the technical partner to MMC sales and customers. Join conversations with prospects, customers, and vendors. Vet customization use cases quickly and explain what is possible, what it takes, and what the tradeoffs are, so deals move forward with confidence.
Practice solution engineering. Turn ambiguous customer needs into clear, scoped, supportable solutions. Translate between customers, sales, product, and engineering, and keep every party aligned.
Build and deliver after close. Plan and schedule the work, and deliver customer functionality with high quality.
Turn one-off builds into platform capabilities. Spot the solutions worth generalizing and graduate them into reusable capabilities for all customers, not only MMC.
Lead and grow the MMC team. Manage 2-4 direct reports. Own coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft.
Deliver the MMC charter. Partner with product and design to deliver the engineering commitments in the current MMC charter.
Own system health. Be accountable for DORA metrics and the health of all MMC-related services.
Stay hands-on. Contribute through code and design reviews, architecture, and thorny debugging, and go deep with architecture leads on the path to mature solutions.
What We're Looking For

You lead from the front. You are close to the code, technically respected, and you grow engineers through clear feedback.
You communicate clearly and directly. You explain complex tradeoffs to customers, vendors, sales, and executives, and you build trust quickly with external parties.
You think like a solution engineer. You can listen to a customer, find the real need, and shape a solution that is realistic to build and support.
You build with AI daily and expect your team to do the same.
You hold strong opinions, loosely. You have a view on how AI changes architecture, team structure, and engineering culture.

About Green Project: Green Project is a SaaS-based carbon accounting and ESG data management platform, explicitly designed to support organizations earlier in their sustainability journey engage with, and improve upon, their environmental performance data. Using Green Project’s platform, businesses of any size can begin tracking and monitoring their sustainability data via our streamlined onboarding processes, flexible data collection tools & automation, and accessible analytics & reporting features. Ultimately, our platform provides the intuitive launchpad that many companies need to begin tracking and reducing their corporate footprint, then consistently strengthen their commitment to decarbonization as their ESG ownership, education, and accountability grows over time.
Job Overview: Join Green Project as a Carbon Reporting Associate and be a part of a fast-growing, remote-first climate tech company that's empowering businesses of all ESG maturities to kickstart or deepen their commitment to sustainability. As a crucial member of our Customer Success team, you'll be at the forefront of both (i) externally defining, quantifying, analyzing and reporting on our client’s GHG footprints, and (ii) internally bolstering our methodological rigor, breadth of disclosure, and data management processes. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, from kickoff, boundary setting, and data collection planning through final deliverables, keeping each one on schedule and within the agreed scope.
Develop and verify Scope 1, 2 and 3 inventories in line with the GHG Protocol using the Green Project platform and Excel, quality-checking data and results before delivery.
Present results to client sustainability, finance, and operations stakeholders, and support their reporting requests such as CDP responses, customer questionnaires, and investor ESG surveys.
Train client teams on the Green Project platform and on data collection, using and improving our standard training materials.
Flag scope changes, adoption risks, and renewal or expansion opportunities to the account team early, and capture lessons learned in the team's templates and playbooks.
Run day-to-day delivery independently using our established methods, with general direction when you take on a type of engagement that's new to you.
Choose the right approach for each client's situation and escalate methodology questions or client risks to a senior team member, who also reviews your deliverables before they go out.
Build productive working relationships with client teams and with our Sales, Product and Data colleagues.
Requirements:
1–4 years of experience in carbon accounting, sustainability consulting, ESG reporting, or a client-facing role at a sustainability SaaS company.
Experience developing and verifying corporate GHG inventories, with working knowledge of the GHG Protocol, including location- and market-based Scope 2 and the Scope 3 categories.
Proven ability to manage several engagements at once while holding to scope, deadlines, and schedules.
Highly proficient in Excel and data analysis, with a keen eye for accuracy and detail.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical results and train non-technical audiences.
Experience with CDP, CSRD, SBTi, or other reporting and target-setting frameworks.
Experience with private equity portfolios, multi-entity clients, or supplier engagement programs.
Experience with CRM and project tracking tools; HubSpot experience is a plus.

$80,000-90,000 base. Actual base pay may vary based on various factors such as location, job-related knowledge, skills, level and experience. The base pay is just one component of the total competitive compensation package for employees.

The chance to be part of and lead a growing, fast-moving team while making a significant impact on the environment.
A competitive salary and benefits package.
A supportive and inclusive culture, with a focus on collaboration and teamwork.
A remote-first work environment and flexible scheduling
